project_type: React SPA with SSR prerendering, Vite 7 build system
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install from repo root. 2. Run the client build. 3. Run vitest. 4. Start dev server and verify HTML is served.
environment_constraints: Node 22, pnpm available, OPEN_INTERNET network mode
key_patterns: Vite config at apps/frontend/vite.config.js uses react() plugin, path alias @/ -> src/, manual chunk splitting, custom plugins for SEO/bot rendering. The oxc top-level config and optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions are INVALID Vite 7 keys that are silently ignored.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/frontend (React SPA), apps/backend (FastAPI), apps/edge (Cloudflare Workers). Frontend uses Vite 7, React 18, react-router-dom 7, TailwindCSS.
